Abhishek Sharma sets T20I world record for fastest 2000 runs

Abhishek Sharma has become the fastest batter to score 2000 runs in T20 Internationals, setting a new world record. He surpassed Suryakumar Yadav in achieving this milestone during the third T20 match, where he displayed exceptional batting performance.
